[[File:GraciousGovernmentMix.png|thumb|250px|"Gracious Government Mix" box of candy]]
'''Candy''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]]. Young [[Youngling/Legends|children]] were fond of candy. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] holiday of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] often had candy being distributed by [[Saun Dann]], although this ended up stolen by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] before they could reach their destination, and were in turn taken by the portly [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[TK-555]] who ate a lot of it before ultimately giving the candy to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] in exchange for the latter's silence to his superiors due to guilt upon learning it was meant to be delivered to poor children.<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
